summary: Mrs. Hidary explores the themes of faith and doubt in Parashat Yitro, beginning with a review of the previous Parasha, Beshalah. She examines the arrival of Yitro and his transformation from the Kohen Midyan to a figure who recognizes the miraculous nature of the Exodus.
questions: How does the Torah contrast the natural world with divine miracles?
What does the story of Amalek teach us about doubt?
Why does the Torah describe Yitro with different titles as the story unfolds?
What is the connection between our hands and faith?
